about_the_game:
welcome to the TOTS prologue, a haunted puzzle-adventure set in the town of Rot Wood, where every night is Halloween.

NOTES:

in this introductory chapter, you will:

  • EXPLORE A HAUNTED WOOD
    explore the haunting landscape of Rot Wood under the cover of night. uncover its secrets and survive its dangers.

  • WIELD TRANSFORMATIVE MASKS
    discover and wield powerful masks that radically transform your abilities and how you interact with the world.

  • MULTIPLE PATHS TO SUCCESS
    collect candy for a quick win or perform a series of perfect tricks to summon a legendary Star Coin.

  • EXPERIENCE A SELF-CONTAINED TALE
    immerse yourself in a complete story that teases a much bigger mystery — the kind that might involve a certain forgotten summer camp.

  • NOTE ON PROGRESS
    this is a demo experience. progress is designed for this single session and will not carry over to the full game.

FEATURED CHARACTERS:

their story unfolds through sharp dialogue and in-game events, revealing a larger mystery tied to the forgotten Camp Slayjoy.

  • JACKO
    a ghost who believes a well-aimed pumpkin blast is the highest form of puzzle-solving. he'll suffer a new mask to pull a better trick, all in the name of perfecting Halloween.

  • WOODY
    a treating purist and master of collection. his ninja-like evasion makes a barrel the perfect costume. he brings flawless strategy to balance Jacko's chaotic force

  • CC
    the enigmatic bus driver with a sweet tooth and a sharp tongue. she has a mysterious magnetic pull for candy and acts as a mentor to the lost ghosts of Rot Wood.

  • KIT
    a fearless Kitsune fox spirit with the ability to duplicate itself. the decoy collects candy and attracts enemy fire while Kit operates with untouchable precision.

wishlist and we’ll notify you ahead of the full release.
